How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question - starting off the right way helps your furniture last much longer. Here are a few simple tips for your first time using new upholstered furniture:
Let it air out first
New furniture can have a light smell from packaging. Place it in a well‑ventilated room for a week or two so the scent fades naturally.
Use it gently at first
Avoid jumping on it, sitting on the arms, or dragging it across the floor. Always lift it from the base when moving.
Keep it protected from sunlight and heat
Place it at least 50 cm away from radiators, heaters, or strong sunlight to prevent fading.
Clean spills right away
If something spills, blot it with a clean dry cloth - don’t rub. For stains, use mild soap and water and test in a hidden area first.  
Regular light maintenance
Vacuum or dust the fabric regularly to keep it looking fresh.
These simple habits help keep your furniture looking great for years. Did that help you feel more confident about using your new piece? 😊
